$comment: Manifest for the tool-schema projection corpus. The follow-up invariant test (task azmt) loads fixtures by walking this manifest's entries. Each entry maps a fixture file (relative to this directory) to a corpus group and an optional list of projection shapes it exercises.

builtin.$comment: Snapshots of real built-in tool schemas: role-based (worker/planner/lead/reviewer/architect from djinn-agent insta snapshots) plus the full DjinnMcpServer::all_tool_schemas() corpus (generated from djinn-control-plane). See README.md.

regression.$comment: Named regression schemas for known-bad JSON Schema shapes from proposal mpen.
